china-1928:p0231_2.rationale: Pilotage tariff for steamers at Canton/Whampoa, with charges scaled by draught; a transport charge schedule.
review_questions: Pilotage as a port service has no dedicated tag; freight-and-transport-costs is the closest fit.

china-1928:p0232_1.rationale: Additional pilotage fees for vessels above Whampoa, berth shifting and pilot retention charges; transport service charges.
review_questions: Consider a dedicated pilotage or port-charges tag.

china-1928:p0236_1.rationale: Yearly initial output of one-cent copper coins, 1904-1908, illustrating overproduction of copper currency.

china-1928:p0237_1.rationale: Number of copper cents per dollar at Shanghai, 1912-1925, showing depreciation of the copper currency against the dollar. It is a domestic exchange rate between coin types, so the currency tag suits it.

china-1928:p0237_2.rationale: Percentage loss on converting copper-cent income into dollars, used to illustrate copper currency depreciation. The tramway company is the example, not the subject.

china-1928:p0238_1.rationale: Total imports, exports and net imports of bar silver and sycee in Haikwan taels over 1892-1925; a commodity trade table concerning silver.

china-1928:p0238_2.rationale: Silver bars imported to Shanghai in 1926 by origin (U.S.A., London, Eastern ports); silver bullion movement.

china-1928:p0238_3.rationale: Uses of imported silver bars in 1926: coinage versus conversion into sycee and the arts.

china-1928:p0239_1.rationale: Weight and fineness of the principal taels current in China; monetary unit standards.

china-1928:p0239_2.rationale: Schedule converting 100,000 troy ounces of bar silver at various finenesses into Shanghai tael proceeds; a unit conversion table.
